label: Pérez-Mañá 2022
setting: public hospital ophthalmology consultation (Hospital de la Esperanza, Barcelona, n=257) and private ophthalmology clinic (Institut Català de la Retina, n=108)
diagnosis_mix: visual impairment group (n=170): dry AMD 25.3% (43); exudative AMD 32.9% (56); cataracts 28.2% (48); glaucoma 11.2% (19); diabetic retinopathy 8.8% (15); other 12.9% (22); healthy group n=195, diagnoses NR
recruitment: 365 consecutive patients; stable visual parameters (VA change <0.1 logMAR in last 6 months); VI group BCVA best eye equal or inferior to 0.30 logMAR (public) or 0.52 logMAR (private); healthy group BCVA worst eye equal or superior to 0.10 logMAR; clear-cut case and control groups (authors note possible over-estimation); healthy group younger than VI group
notes: Overall age and sex not reported for whole sample: VI group 78.8 +/- 10.0 y (n=170), 47.7% men; healthy 68.7 +/- 11.5 y (n=195), 42.1% men (p4, Table 1 p5). pct_female = (89+113)/365 = 55.3 derived from Table 1 p5. pct_glaucoma 11.2 is the VI group only (p4). Public hospital sample did 3 questionnaires by telephone; private clinic SLVQOL alone face-to-face (p3). Administration time reported in seconds per group (p5-6), see effects.csv. Table 4 p6 states VI n=157 vs 170 in text. Spanish LVQOL called LVQOL/SLVQOL in text.
